title: FlashType anti-alias mode — CSMTextSettings and DefineFontAlignZones
description: Add antiAlias field to the text model (five modes: device, bitmap, animation, readability/FlashType, custom), surface it in PropertiesPanel, and emit CSMTextSettings + DefineFontAlignZones tags in the SWF compiler for the FlashType modes. Without this, all text compiles as animation anti-alias and Flash 8's crisp FlashType readability mode is unavailable.
